For the first time in more than a decade, #CA51 residents will see their Medicare Part B premiums decrease!
 
When we passed the #InflationReductionAct, we committed to lowering health care costs for people across our nation.

Agriculture and nutrition policy go hand-in-hand. We can’t talk about fighting hunger in America without supporting our farmers and ranchers!

I stand with my @HouseAgDem colleagues in promising to #DefendSNAP as we celebrate the farmers who feed us this #AgDay23. https://t.co/tfRqFFwoPe

• Corky Smith Gymnasium, 274 Pico Ave., San Marcos

I’m proud to have signed onto the tri-caucus letter, with more than 60 of my colleagues, urging @secbecerra to reinstate Medicaid coverage for over 500,000 children & adults. Thank you for protecting vulnerable families & informing states & territories of their legal duties.

46 years ago today, the 1977 Food Stamp Act was signed into law, setting the framework for the modern Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) we know today. I’m proud to continually support SNAP so that families and those in need can put food on their tables.

Now’s the time to review and compare your Medicare coverage options for 2024. See if you can find lower costs or better coverage, or just make sure your current choice is still the best way to go:

I'm proud to support @RepSteel 's bipartisan legislation to develop recommendations & best practices for patients seeking to navigate language differences in our healthcare system.

Healthcare is essential for your overall well-being. It’s time to enroll, review, or renew health coverage for 2024. Sign up by December 15! 

Learn more:
https://t.co/QaGpEYakxR

In #CA52, ACA enrollees are saving $1,000 on premiums thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act. Average premiums in the district were $1,890, but without the IRA, they'd have surged 58% to $2,900. Affordable healthcare matters!

@hospitals4kids recently released their latest report on the role Children’s Hospitals have in providing care to children of Military families. Thank you for ensuring crucial healthcare needs are met for Military and Veteran families.

Thank you to the federally funded health center organizations in the 52nd Congressional District that leveraged millions in federal investments to serve more than 360,000 patients! The work you do for our communities is invaluable. #HealthcareForAll

Great meeting with Imperial Beach Mayor @paloma4ib & Chula Vista @MayorJohnMcCann. We need to secure funds & stop sewage flow into our communities. I urge House leadership to support improvements at the South Bay International Wastewater Treatment Plant! 
https://t.co/kL1prZonPG

More people signed up for #healthcare thanks to increased federal subsidies from the Inflation Reduction Act and California's new cost-sharing program You can still enroll until midnight, tonight, Feb 9th for coverage! https://t.co/YCTIjZKOeg

We need strong coordination between the US & Mexico to address Tijuana River Valley pollution.

I joined a binational group of officials to discuss how we can continue to work together on this issue and to check in on San Antonio de los Buenos treatment plant construction. https://t.co/4xjQeJ0EVm

The IBWC just announced that it awarded the contract for a project to double the capacity of the South Bay International Wastewater Treatment Plant! This will put the $400 million our Congressional delegation secured for the plant to work & help address Tijuana River pollution. https://t.co/eTYKFiHjjb

This will put to use the $400M that our Delegation secured to expand the plant but we have more work to do. We need an accelerated construction timeline for this project. Our communities feel the impact of the pollution every day. We cannot afford to wait. https://t.co/7Oj9jEJx2t

Yesterday we marked the start of a vital project to upgrade the South Bay treatment plant. This project will use $400 million in federal funding that our Congressional delegation secured to double the plant’s capacity & combat Tijuana River Valley pollution. 

We won't let up. https://t.co/s2KOlCO4FA

NEW: @POTUS just included $310M to upgrade the South Bay wastewater treatment plant and combat Tijuana River Valley pollution in his disaster relief supplemental funding request to Congress.

This is funding our San Diego Congressional delegation has been pushing for.

We recently marked World AIDS Day, a reminder that the fight against the HIV/AIDS epidemic continues. 

Let’s ensure that HIV prevention, treatment, and care is accessible to ALL. Together, we can save lives.

NEW: We just passed $250 million to combat cross-border sewage pollution. These federal dollars will fully fund critical upgrades to the South Bay treatment plant. 

Thank you to everyone who fought alongside our San Diego delegation for this funding. This is a big step forward.

I just joined my colleagues to announce an additional $250 M in federal funds to expand the South Bay wastewater treatment plant.

Together, our delegation has secured over half a billion dollars to upgrade the plant and combat Tijuana River Valley pollution.

We won't let up. https://t.co/laYLTFxqM9

Schools, places of worship, and hospitals provide essential services to all. They should not be sites of immigration enforcement.

I remain committed to doing everything in my power to protect our communities.
https://t.co/W63nkJ0Kwm

Trump and Republicans in Congress are pushing an $880 BILLION cut to Medicaid (or Medi-Cal here in CA) to give billionaires a tax break. 

In what world is it okay to take from children, seniors, and working families to give to the ultra-wealthy? I voted NO on this plan before and I will vote no again on any attempts to slash Medicaid, Social Security, and the programs our communities rely on.

The Republican budget includes $7 TRILLION in giveaways to the wealthiest while making the largest cuts to Medicaid and food assistance in history.

I oppose taking food and health care from working families to pay for tax cuts for billionaires. Simple as that.

I voted NO. https://t.co/ZFXBUyrAsB

Last week, House Republicans voted to take another step towards making the largest cuts to Medicaid (or Medi-Cal here in CA) in history. I'll keep fighting to stop these devastating cuts from becoming a reality.  https://t.co/Xve9Ty3iRn
